records.vts_boundary_basis: No VTS coverage established. records.source_date: Directive 1226-r of 2 Sep 2006 (unofficial copy); Korsakov draft rules, file dated 2013; accessed 29 Sep 2026
records.unresolved_issue: Current approved Korsakov port rules not obtained (only a Mintrans draft); no official complete list of Russian VTS/VTS zones for Sakhalin; identity of IMO B-X/3 geometry with Directive 1226-r Scheme No. 6 not checked against Ships' Routeing 2025; UKHO/Russian Notices to Mariners not checked.

records.prior_lead_outcome: confirmed: Unresolved; Korsakov VTS lead now shown not to reach the scheme on the draft zone description

records.vts_boundary_basis: Lead only, probably partial. records.vts_boundary_basis: MSC.389(94) (Z3-S1), the IMO instrument for VRS-0022, names Chengshan Jiao VTS Centre (Weihai MSA) as the shore authority for the 24 nm reporting area, states the Centre has radar and a continuous 24-hour watch and provides traffic information to participating ships, requires a listening watch on the VTS working channel, and requires ships NUC or at anchor 'in the TSSs' to report to VTS. COLREG.2/Circ.66 (Z3-S2) cross-refers the TSS to the SRS. VTS extent is therefore taken from the IMO instrument's 24 nm area; no separate national VTS area description (Chinese VTS rules for Chengshan Jiao) was located. The inner TSS vertices lie 3.1 to 15.1 nm from the Centre.
records.reporting_authority: Weihai Maritime Safety Administration; reports to Chengshan Jiao VTS Centre (VHF 08, secondary 09 or 65)
records.reporting_boundary_basis: SRS area is the 24 nm circle centred on the VTS Centre (MSC.389(94) para 2.1). All vertices of the inner TSS (points 1-9, 13-15, 26-27) lie between 3.1 and 15.1 nm from the circle centre, so the whole scheme lies inside the 24 nm area. Participation: passenger ships; oil tankers 150 GT and above and ships carrying hazardous cargo; LOA over 200 m or draught over 12 m; towing/pushing vessels; ships NUC, at anchor in the TSSs, RAM or with defective navigational equipment.
records.evidence_summary: IMO Part I system VRS-0022 (MSC.389(94), in force 1 June 2015) covers a 24 nm circle around Chengshan Jiao VTS Centre; the TSS coordinates in COLREG.2/Circ.66 were measured against that circle. All vertices of the inner TSS (points 1-9, 13-15, 26-27) lie between 3.1 and 15.1 nm from the circle centre, so the whole scheme lies inside the 24 nm area. The same IMO instrument establishes the VTS Centre as operating the system with radar and 24-hour watch.

records.vts_boundary_basis: No VTS established. The IMO instruments name MRCC Las Palmas (Salvamento Marítimo) only as a Maritime Rescue Co-ordination Centre receiving CANREP reports and voluntary TSS notifications (Z3-S3, Z3-S4). An official press release (Z3-S9) says CCS Las Palmas carries out traffic monitoring, and a media report (Z3-S10) says the CCS 'controlled' ships transiting the TSS, but no official source was found that designates a VTS or defines a VTS area covering the TSS. The Las Palmas / Santa Cruz de Tenerife port VTS cover port waters only (not checked in detail; lead only).
records.reporting_scheme_name: CANREP (Mandatory ship reporting system for the Canary Islands)
records.reporting_authority: Salvamento Marítimo: MRCC Las Palmas (entry east of 015°30'W) / MRCC Tenerife (entry west of 015°30'W)
records.reporting_boundary_basis: CANREP area is a polygon (points A-N) along the outer limit of the territorial sea around the archipelago (MSC.213(81) para 2.1). Plotting the COLREG.2/Circ.57 coordinates shows all Eastern TSS points inside the polygon; its northern termination (points 3 and 11-12 at about 28°20'N, on the line CANREP D-E) lies on the CANREP boundary line within 0.05', and the polygon vertex used for the TSS's inshore traffic zone coincides with a CANREP vertex, so the TSS lies within the reporting area. Applies only to tankers of 600 dwt and above carrying heavy crude, heavy fuel oil, bitumen or tar.
records.voluntary_reporting: Yes: voluntary notification of entry to and departure from the TSS via MRCC Las Palmas, VHF channel 16 (COLREG.2/Circ.57 note)
records.evidence_summary: Inside VRS-0023 CANREP (MSC.213(81), in force 1 Dec 2006) by coordinate check; mandatory only for heavy-grade oil tankers of 600 dwt and above. MRCC Las Palmas is an MRCC, not a designated VTS; traffic monitoring of the TSS by Salvamento Marítimo is reported but no VTS designation or VTS area was found.
records.source_date: MSC.213(81) adopted 12 May 2006, in force 1 Dec 2006; COLREG.2/Circ.57 26 May 2006, implemented 1 Dec 2006; press release 20 Nov 2020; media 2 Feb 2024; accessed 29 Sep 2026
records.unresolved_issue: Salvamento Marítimo website unavailable (TLS/503), so its own description of CCS functions and any Spanish designation of a coastal VTS for the Canary TSS could not be checked; ALRS Vol 6 not consulted. CANREP chartlet not inspected (coordinate check used instead).
records.vts_leads: MRCC Las Palmas / CCS (Salvamento Marítimo) traffic monitoring of the TSS (not a designated VTS on the evidence found)
records.prior_lead_outcome: confirmed: MRS only (CANREP); inclusion now checked by plotting TSS coordinates against the CANREP polygon

batch_audits.pass2_evidence_check: Reopened MSC.389(94) and COLREG.2/Circ.66 local copies and re-verified the SRS circle, authority and TSS coordinates; distances recomputed ellipsoidally for boundary-critical points. Reopened Nakhodka rules (RG original and legalacts consolidation), Directive 1226-r and Korsakov draft; quoted passages re-checked verbatim. Prior 'VTS only' for TSS-0218 removed as not established to Tier 1/2 current standard.
batch_audits.pass3_classification_duplicate_check: VRS-0022 reused, not re-allocated; Chengshan Jiao VTS Centre recorded once and linked to TSS-0219/0220 (and TSS-0221/0222 in B45). VTS versus SRS: the VTS extent is derived from the IMO SRS instrument that names the VTS Centre as operator; flagged. Parent B-X/6 versus components: each component checked separately against the 24 nm circle. Russian VTS communication duties treated as part of VTS, not MRS. Regional VTS of Peter the Great Gulf and Korsakov VTS recorded as leads only.
batch_audits.unresolved_items: TSS-0216: current Korsakov rules and any other Russian VTS; TSS-0217: TSS coordinates and current Nakhodka rules; TSS-0218: current Nakhodka rules, territorial sea limit, match of IMO B-X/5 to national Scheme No. 3; TSS-0219/0220: national VTS area description not found.

batch_audits.pass2_evidence_check: Reopened MSC.389(94)/COLREG.2/Circ.66 for East and South (East found partial: points 22-23 at 24.1 and 25.7 nm). Reopened MSC.213(81) and COLREG.2/Circ.57 and plotted both Canary TSS against the CANREP polygon (point-in-polygon test; northern terminations lie on the CANREP boundary within 0.05'). Voluntary notification notes re-quoted. Canary VTS: no official VTS designation found; press release and media treated as Tier 4 / lead only.
batch_audits.pass3_classification_duplicate_check: VRS-0022 and VRS-0023 reused; one CANREP entity linked to both Canary TSS; MRCC Las Palmas / Tenerife recorded as MRCCs, not VTS; mandatory CANREP (tankers only) separated from voluntary TSS notification. Chengshan Jiao VTS Centre not duplicated.
batch_audits.unresolved_items: TSS-0221: eastern end beyond 24 nm, VTS operation there undocumented; TSS-0221/0222: national VTS area description not found; TSS-0223/0224: Salvamento Marítimo site and ALRS Vol 6 not checked for any coastal VTS designation.

method_notes: Research 29 Sep 2026. IMO resolutions and COLREG.2 circulars downloaded and text-extracted with pypdf; TSS coordinates plotted: Chengshan Jiao points measured against the 24 nm SRS circle (Vincenty on WGS 84 for boundary-critical points; equirectangular for others, error well under 0.1 nm at these ranges); Canary TSS points tested against the CANREP polygon (ray casting on geographic coordinates). Russian port rules read from Rossiyskaya Gazeta (2011 original) and a legalacts.ru consolidation (to 15.12.2017); Consultant/Garant blocked. Korsakov rules only available as Mintrans draft .doc files (text extracted from UTF-16 binary). Salvamento Marítimo website failed (TLS chain error / HTTP 503); TLS verification was not disabled. Chinese national VTS rules for Chengshan Jiao not found in searches of MOT/MSA and secondary hosts. TSS names follow the input records (IMO component names 'North', 'East', 'South'). No repository files edited.
